meta.title: Parking at your destination
meta.description: Search an address or place and see the disabled parking spaces and garages nearby. No account needed.

hero.eyebrow: For everyone with a disabled parking card
hero.title: Park at your destination without circling the block
hero.intro: Search an address or place and see which disabled parking spaces are nearby. If the street is full, you can see straight away which garage still has room.
hero.intro_short: Search an address or place and see which disabled parking spaces are nearby.
hero.label: Where are you going?

preview.alt: Map around the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam with disabled parking spaces and a garage with free spaces
preview.title: Parking results

legend.title: How to read the map
legend.intro: Each marker shows what kind of place it is. Choose one to see the details.

space.title: Disabled parking space
space.text: From the municipality or added by a user. The details show which times and rules apply.

garage.title: Garage or P+R
garage.text: The number shows the free spaces in the whole garage, not specifically the disabled spaces.

cluster.title: Several places
cluster.text: Places close together are grouped. Zoom in to see them individually.

destination.title: Your destination
destination.text: Distances are measured from this point, so you can see which place is closest.

garages.title: Street full? See which garage still has room
garages.text: For each municipality you can see how many spaces garages and park-and-ride sites have free right now, with the time of the latest measurement.
garages.text_short: Current occupancy per garage and P+R, with the time of measurement.

contribute.title: Is a place missing?
contribute.text: You often know your own neighbourhood and the places you visit regularly best. Add a disabled parking space you know in a few steps and help other visitors find their way. Every contribution makes the map more complete.
contribute.step: Put the pin on the spot
contribute.next: Then fill in the orientation and any time limits
